description: BUILD A WORLD: designs a living world (a calm world-history sandbox where nations rise, split, sign pacts and fall on their own) and returns its share link, which anyone can open to watch it run, and the cleaned spec. Nothing is created on the server and no token is needed. To sit in the world yourself, pass the returned spec as "world" to join_war with room "new", then start_war: you lead one nation and the others are run by the house.

groups.description: Optional: your own empires, each {"name": "...", "color": [r,g,b], "members": ["ISO3", ...]} folded from real countries (the first member leads). Starts on real borders.

nations.description: How many nations (default 42; 200 with a date pack or real borders).

relief.description: Real mountains and forests: the Alps, Himalaya, Andes... slow every march.

rules.description: calm: no doomsday clock, no nukes, endless (default); war: the full war rules; mayhem: cheap early nukes.

seas.description: Rising seas in years mode: the great low deltas turn to marsh from 2050.

start.description: "normal" (patches of land), "borders" (every country on its real 2026 borders), "pixel" (one cell each), or a date pack: era1914, era1939, era1962, era1991, era0117, era1279, era1453, era1648, era1815, era1871, era1945, era2100.

title.description: Optional: the world's title, up to 60 characters.

year.description: Optional: the year the world starts in (years mode).

years.description: Years mode: one minute is one year, leaders age and die (default false).

name: build_world
